mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.model, r.match_id, r.league_name, DATE_FORMAT(r.match_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS match_time, r.home_team, r.guest_team, r.stage, r.market, r.direction, r.handicap, r.handicap AS display_handicap, r.odds, r.rate, r.final_score, COALESCE(r.recommend_role, 'primary') AS recommend_role, r.result_status, r.is_latest AS is_latest, r.final_home_score, r.final_guest_score, DATE_FORMAT(r.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS create_time, DATE_FORMAT(r.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS update_time FROM football_ai_recommend_record r

SELECT r.id, r.model, r.match_id, r.league_name, DATE_FORMAT(r.match_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS match_time, r.home_team, r.guest_team, r.stage, r.market, r.direction, r.handicap, r.handicap AS display_handicap, r.odds, r.rate, r.final_score, COALESCE(r.recommend_role, 'primary') AS recommend_role, r.recommend_home_score, r.recommend_guest_score, r.recommend_minute, COALESCE(s.home_red, r.home_red, 0) AS home_red, COALESCE(s.guess_red, r.guest_red, 0) AS guest_red, r.result_status, r.is_latest AS is_latest, r.final_home_score, r.final_guest_score, DATE_FORMAT(r.settle_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS settle_time, DATE_FORMAT(r.obsolete_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS obsolete_time, DATE_FORMAT(r.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS create_time, DATE_FORMAT(r.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS update_time, s.match_status, s.match_type, s.match_score, s.corn_score, s.asia_handicap, s.big_small FROM football_ai_recommend_record r LEFT JOIN t_leisu_schedule s ON s.match_id = r.match_id
mapper.select:
ORDER BY r.rate DESC, r.create_time DESC, r.id DESC
ORDER BY r.create_time DESC, r.id DESC
ORDER BY r.match_time ASC, r.id DESC
ORDER BY r.match_time DESC, r.create_time DESC, r.id DESC
LIMIT #{q.offset}, #{q.limit}

SELECT COUNT(1) AS all_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.result_status = 0 AND r.is_latest=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.result_status IN (1,3,4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hit_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.result_status IN (1,2,3,4,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finished_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.result_status = 9 OR r.is_latest=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS obsolete_count FROM football_ai_recommend_record r

SELECT r.id, r.model, r.sport, r.match_id, r.league_name, DATE_FORMAT( r.match_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS match_time, r.home_team, r.guest_team, r.stage, r.market, r.direction, r.handicap, r.handicap AS display_handicap, r.odds, r.rate, r.final_score, COALESCE( r.recommend_role, 'primary' ) AS recommend_role, r.recommend_home_score, r.recommend_guest_score, r.recommend_minute, r.home_red, r.guest_red, r.result_status, r.is_latest, r.final_home_score, r.final_guest_score, DATE_FORMAT( r.settle_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS settle_time, DATE_FORMAT( r.obsolete_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS obsolete_time, DATE_FORMAT( r.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS create_time, DATE_FORMAT( r.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS update_time FROM football_ai_recommend_record r WHERE r.match_id = #{matchId} AND r.id != #{currentId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.sql: p.id AS prediction_id, p.model_platform, p.match_id, p.model_version, p.lambda_home, p.lambda_away, p.p_home, p.p_draw, p.p_away, p.score_home, p.score_away, p.elo_weight, p.pick_market, p.pick_direction, p.pick_handicap, p.pick_odds, p.pick_kelly, p.euro_direction, p.euro_odds, p.euro_prob, p.euro_kelly, p.euro_status, p.ou_direction, p.ou_line, p.ou_odds, p.ou_prob, p.ou_kelly, p.ou_status, p.asia_direction, p.asia_line, p.asia_odds, p.asia_prob, p.asia_kelly, p.asia_status, p.analysis_json, COALESCE( p.final_home_score, ( SELECT p2.final_home_score FROM football_prediction p2 WHERE p2.match_id = p.match_id AND p2.model_platform = p.model_platform AND p2.final_home_score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p2.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) ) AS final_home_score, COALESCE( p.final_away_score, ( SELECT p2.final_away_score FROM football_prediction p2 WHERE p2.match_id = p.match_id AND p2.model_platform = p.model_platform AND p2.final_away_score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p2.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) ) AS final_away_score, p.result_status, ( SELECT r.result_status FROM football_ai_recommend_record r WHERE r.match_id = p.match_id AND r.model = CASE WHEN p.model_platform = 'antscore' THEN 'nami' ELSE 'jiebao' END ORDER BY r.is_latest DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS ranking_status, ( SELECT r.market FROM football_ai_recommend_record r WHERE r.match_id = p.match_id AND r.model = CASE WHEN p.model_platform = 'antscore' THEN 'nami' ELSE 'jiebao' END ORDER BY r.is_latest DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS ranking_market, ( SELECT r.direction FROM football_ai_recommend_record r WHERE r.match_id = p.match_id AND r.model = CASE WHEN p.model_platform = 'antscore' THEN 'nami' ELSE 'jiebao' END ORDER BY r.is_latest DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS ranking_direction, ( SELECT r.handicap FROM football_ai_recommend_record r WHERE r.match_id = p.match_id AND r.model = CASE WHEN p.model_platform = 'antscore' THEN 'nami' ELSE 'jiebao' END ORDER BY r.is_latest DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS ranking_handicap, s.stage AS snapshot_stage, s.league_name, DATE_FORMAT(s.match_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS match_time, s.home_team, s.away_team, ( SELECT r.id FROM football_ai_recommend_record r WHERE r.match_id = p.match_id AND r.model = CASE WHEN p.model_platform = 'antscore' THEN 'nami' ELSE 'jiebao' END ORDER BY r.is_latest DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS recommendation_id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY p.match_id ORDER BY CASE s.stage WHEN '即时盘' THEN 0 WHEN '初盘' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, p.id DESC ) AS replay_rank FROM football_prediction p INNER JOIN football_feature_snapshot s ON s.id = p.snapshot_id WHERE p.model_platform = #{platform} AND p.match_id = #{matchId} AND s.stage IN ('初盘', '即时盘') ) ranked WHERE ranked.replay_rank = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY p.match_id ORDER BY CASE s.stage WHEN '即时盘' THEN 0 WHEN '初盘' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, p.id DESC ) AS replay_rank FROM football_prediction p INNER JOIN football_feature_snapshot s ON s.id = p.snapshot_id WHERE p.model_platform = #{platform} AND s.stage IN ('初盘', '即时盘') AND s.match_time >= #{dayStart} AND s.match_time < #{dayEnd} ) ranked WHERE ranked.replay_rank = 1 ORDER BY ranked.match_time ASC, ranked.prediction_id DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(s.match_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(DISTINCT p.match_id) AS matches FROM football_prediction p INNER JOIN football_feature_snapshot s ON s.id = p.snapshot_id WHERE p.model_platform = #{platform} AND s.stage IN ('初盘', '即时盘') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(s.match_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 90
